external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Our project partners are from the Albertus-Magnus Gymnasium in Ettlingen, Germany and this meeting in Brussels was designed to allow our students to meet one another but also to hear more about possible career opportunities in the EU.

The King’s Hospital School is delighted to be exhibiting at the Affordable Boarding Show in Central London on Friday 30 and Saturday 31 October 2026, meeting families interested in discovering more about boarding education in Ireland.

external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Taking place at City of London School for Boys, 107 Queen Victoria Street, London, the event will bring together schools and families to explore boarding options, academic pathways and the opportunities available to students beyond the classroom.
